name: Late Night Escapades of Eep
source:
The halls are slimy, the ceiling drips, and the new student is missing. Eep didn’t sign up for this kind of school day – but he’s the only one who can figure it out.

[From [url=https://pspiso.itch.io/late-night-escapades-of-eep]Itch.io[/url]]

大厅里黏糊糊的，天花板在滴水，新生也失踪了。艾普没有报名参加这样的学校活动——但他是唯一能弄清楚这一点的人。
